con.text: Malfegor killed the archangel Asha in Bant during the splitting of Alara, leaving the throne empty, and was exiled to Grixis.
After the Mending, Nicol Bolas ordered Malfegor to assemble an army of necromancers and undead against the other Shards.
Rafiq was given the sword that had been broken in Asha's battle with Malfegor, and he and Elspeth Tirel killed Malfegor in Bant, after which chaos reigned among the factions of Grixis.
